steps.label: Arrangement Review
steps.caption: Assessing authority identifies complex corporate restructuring steps.

steps.label: Tax Benefit Check
steps.caption: System verifies reduction or deferral of statutory tax liabilities.

steps.label: Safe Harbour Audit
steps.caption: Authority checks aggregate tax benefit against statutory threshold.

steps.label: Notice Formulation
steps.caption: Officer drafts statutory notice to invoke general anti avoidance rules.

steps.label: Substance Test
steps.caption: Panel evaluates whether form differs from true economic reality.

steps.label: Round Trip Analysis
steps.caption: System traces circular transfer of funds across offshore accounts.

steps.label: Conduit Detection
steps.caption: Authority identifies accommodating entities lacking business substance.

steps.label: Tainted Element Finding
steps.caption: Panel confirms presence of statutorily tainted transaction element.

steps.label: Look Through Order
steps.caption: Officer disregards intermediary corporate step in transaction chain.

steps.label: Party Consolidation
steps.caption: Authority treats accommodating conduit and parent as identical entity.

steps.label: Hybrid Reclassification
steps.caption: Officer recharacterizes hybrid debt instrument into taxable equity.

steps.label: Treaty Denial
steps.caption: Domestic anti avoidance rules override bilateral treaty exemptions.

steps.label: Officer Reference
steps.caption: Assessing officer submits formal reference to principal commissioner.

steps.label: Statutory Notice
steps.caption: Commissioner issues show cause notice granting sixty days for response.

steps.label: Collegiate Hearing
steps.caption: Three member panel chaired by high court judge hears oral arguments.

steps.label: Binding Directions
steps.caption: Approving panel issues binding directions within six months of receipt.

steps.label: Safe Harbour Clock
steps.caption: Engine verifies whether tax exposure falls below statutory threshold.

steps.label: Substance Indexing
steps.caption: Platform scores corporate office leases and local employment records.

steps.label: Recharacterization Model
steps.caption: Simulator computes tax adjustments from proposed step disregards.

steps.label: Statutory Docket
steps.caption: Module compiles contemporaneous business defense for approving panel.
